**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 28 already lands on our preferred GOVLAW position:

- **§ 28.1** — Governed by the laws of the State of New York, with conflict-of-law principles disclaimed and CISG excluded.
- **§ 28.2** — Exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts of New York County, with irrevocable submission to personal jurisdiction and waiver of venue/inconvenient-forum objections.
- **No arbitration** — A document-wide search for "arbitration" returned zero hits, and Section 30 (General) contains no dispute-forum provision, so there is no competing or offshore arbitration seat.

Two ancillary items I checked and cleared rather than flagged:

- The § 28.2 carve-out allowing either Party to seek temporary injunctive relief in another court is **mutual** and customary for confidentiality/IP protection — it does not displace the exclusive New York forum.
- The § 28.3 executive-escalation precondition is time-boxed at fifteen business days and expressly does not delay urgent relief or filings needed to preserve a limitations period, so it creates no practical bar to our access to the courts.

No further action needed on this rule.
